Consideration and possible action regarding Environmental Assessment No. 1203, and Zone Text Amendment No. 18-02 to amend certain sections of the El Segundo Municipal Code pertaining to outdoor dining, allowed setback encroachments, and required parking for accessory uses in the Light Industrial (M-1) zone. Pursuant to the provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act, the proposed zone text amendment is not subject to CEQA pursuant to Section 15060(c)(2) of the State CEQA Guidelines because it will not result in a direct or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in the environment. Address: Light Industrial (M-1) Zone of El Segundo.
(Fiscal Impact: None with this action.)
